comments.author: bngybmgrglflps
comments.story: Standard Notes is a safe place for your notes, thoughts, and life's work
comments.why: Upspin as example of encrypted sharing on own terms
comments.text: "Encrypt, store, share [files] on your own terms" is elegantly handled by (Rob Pike's) Upspin. Practically: upspinfs fusermounts a cloud storage bucket. (TCO: $0.01/GB/mo.) Transparent public-key crypto. Sharing is built into the protocol. Sane defaults. [LINK] [VIDEO] Building notes on top feels almost too straightforward to monetize. (For that matter: 1password, any number of small-scale B2C things, ...)
